app_fee.value: The Collège doctoral pages give no application fee for PhD applicants. The €398 registration fee is paid only after admission.

also.quote: The registration fee is €398 for all PhD registrations for the academic year 2026/2027.

fee_waiver.value: No application-fee waiver is stated. The registration-fee exemption applies after admission.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated on the Collège doctoral pages; each doctoral school sets its own admission rules.

toefl_min.value: No TOEFL minimum is stated on the official Collège doctoral or doctoral school pages.

ielts_min.value: No IELTS minimum is stated on the official Collège doctoral or doctoral school pages.

english_waiver.value: No English-test rule, including for Indian degrees, is stated on the official pages.

notes: Admission is by each doctoral school (13 in total), after which the Collège doctoral registers the student. The official English pages give admission conditions (master's or foreign equivalence via CD3) but no English-test or application-fee rule.
